follow_up.question: Why is net debt not deducted after applying P/E?
follow_up.reference: P/E already produces common equity value from common net income. Deducting net debt again would mix an enterprise-value bridge into an equity valuation.

follow_up.reference: Deduct them before applying a common-equity P/E multiple. The earnings numerator must belong to the same common shareholders represented by the price.
